nodes.label: Guest Demo Mode
nodes.rationale: Judges may only get a link; guest data auto-deleted after 24 h

nodes.label: Kill Chain
nodes.rationale: Detect -> Track -> Identify -> Decide -> Respond -> Assess; the core training loop

nodes.label: Feature Priority P0-P3
nodes.rationale: P0 demo loop first, P1 realism differentiators, P2 depth, P3 bonus

nodes.label: Fixed 20 Hz Tick
nodes.rationale: Fixed 50 ms tick with render interpolation decouples sim determinism from display rate

nodes.label: Command Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Trainee actions applied on next tick so replay = re-run scenario + re-apply logged commands

nodes.label: Event Batcher
nodes.rationale: Flushes every 2 s and on end with retry/backoff so flaky networks don't lose sessions

nodes.label: Scenario Generator
nodes.rationale: Python only, seeded random.Random(seed); never port to TS to avoid two generators

nodes.label: Scoring Service
nodes.rationale: Runs on POST complete; server-side so client scores are never trusted

nodes.label: Analytics Service
nodes.rationale: AAR aggregates computed on read; small data, no warehouse needed

nodes.label: AI Service
nodes.rationale: One LLM client, Pydantic-validated output, one retry, template fallback

nodes.label: Trust Boundary
nodes.rationale: Server trusts client sensor events but validates plausibility; never accepts scores

nodes.label: Determinism Contract
nodes.rationale: Same scenario + command log => identical state in browser and Node

nodes.label: Mulberry32 Named RNG Streams
nodes.rationale: Separate named streams so adding a feature doesn't shift other random sequences

nodes.label: ENU Coordinates
nodes.rationale: Flip to Three.js z = -north happens only in coords.ts

nodes.label: EO_IDENTIFIABLE Event
nodes.rationale: Used for fair scoring: classification judged against identifiability

nodes.label: CAMERA_SLEWED Event
nodes.rationale: Throttled to 2/s plus final event per gesture

nodes.label: sim-core
nodes.rationale: Pure deterministic TS, no React/Three/DOM

nodes.label: Track N-of-M Confirmation
nodes.rationale: 3 hits in 5 scans creates track; 4 misses loses it; tracks distinct from contacts so trainee never sees truth

nodes.label: Rain SNR Loss
nodes.rationale: Accepted divergence (decision 50): two-way SNR loss growing with range, ITU-R P.838 style

nodes.label: Alpha-Beta Track Filter
nodes.rationale: Decision 51; track height is true AGL (known truth leak)

nodes.label: EO Video Auto-Track
nodes.rationale: Decision 52: MANUAL/CUE/TRACK states derived from logged commands, no new event type

nodes.label: RF Strobes
nodes.rationale: Sim state not events; RF-only contacts unactionable, not counted detectable

nodes.label: Time Bands
nodes.rationale: Decision 74: bands >= 2 deg clear of -6 deg night rule, NOAA equations

nodes.label: Minimum Warning
nodes.rationale: Shared constants in difficulty.ts; generator targets, validator enforces (decisions 75, 79)

nodes.label: Responses and Effectiveness
nodes.rationale: Abstract by design: decision trainer, not weapons sim

nodes.label: NO_KINETIC Zone
nodes.rationale: Track position tested since intercepts resolve instantly; must move to predicted point if TOF modelled

nodes.label: EW Sector Rules
nodes.rationale: Decision 54: +/-10 deg sector, collateral on friendlies/civilians

nodes.label: Decision Tree Scoring
nodes.rationale: JSON, editable weights, versioned; old versions immutable

nodes.label: default_v2 Tree
nodes.rationale: Adds EW leaves, FRIENDLY_JAMMED, CIVILIAN_JAMMED, per-component denominators

nodes.label: default_v3 Tree
nodes.rationale: Payload drop before neutralised = LEAKED

nodes.label: Fairness Rules
nodes.rationale: No penalty for undetectable contacts; latency from first detectable time

nodes.label: UNAVOIDABLE Rule
nodes.rationale: Decision 56: excludes decision component when leak faster than cooldown

nodes.label: POST /scenarios/generate
nodes.rationale: Decision 80: trainees restricted fields, rate-limited, dedup by request

nodes.label: SIM_VERSION
nodes.rationale: Stored per session so replay can detect sim changes

nodes.label: Sim-Core Validator
nodes.rationale: Playability judged by the sim itself (decisions 74-76, 79)

nodes.label: Text-to-Scenario
nodes.rationale: LLM outputs ScenarioRequest only; deterministic generator builds scenario for validity/reproducibility

nodes.label: AI-Assist Panel
nodes.rationale: Pre-baked seed-determined suggestions, deterministic and replayable

hyperedges.label: Sensor stack feeding the kill chain
